business_problem: collaborate on sensitive consumer and identity data for marketing use cases without increasing privacy risk, copying data, or slowing delivery to clients.
solution_summary: Merkle uses Snowflake, Secure Data Sharing, Data Clean Rooms, and Horizon Catalog on Snowflake to collaborate on sensitive consumer and identity data for marketing use cases without increasing privacy risk, copying data, or slowing delivery to clients. Viewership, streaming, metadata, and audience data are centralized in Snowflake so data, privacy, and partner teams can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. Secure Data Sharing lets the organization collaborate with partners or downstream consumers on live governed data without creating extra copies. Data Clean Rooms let teams collaborate on sensitive data while maintaining privacy controls and reducing compliance risk. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. Merkle achieved 64% faster data development cycle and 20% estimated cost savings.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Provides the centralized data platform that stores governed datasets and serves analytics or AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Secure Data Sharing
solution_components.role: Shares governed data with partners or internal consumers without moving copies.

solution_components.name: Data Clean Rooms
solution_components.role: Enables privacy-safe collaboration and analysis across partner datasets without exposing raw data.

solution_components.name: Horizon Catalog
solution_components.role: Applies cataloging, governance, and policy controls across Snowflake data assets.
